## Summary

Describe the user-visible and technical effect of this change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Focused tests were added or updated when behavior changed.

## Safety review

- [ ] No secrets, raw source data, or untrusted HTML were introduced.
- [ ] Documentation and data-contract changes are included when relevant.
- [ ] This change does not weaken security headers, validation, consent, or
      accessibility requirements.
